107	## Task B — polarized 1×1×1 leaf leak (small frustums reflecting on air:air)
108	
109	### Symptom
110	Frustums with `frustumSize < 2` spuriously "reflect" on pure air:air
111	boundaries that should have R=0.
112	
113	### Root cause (confirmed by direct source reading, not guessed)
114	A genuine 1×1×1 (finest) octree leaf must **never** carry a polarization
115	descriptor (`NodeDescriptor.polar() != null`) — polarity is a coarse-aggregate
116	concept only (baked when a node aggregates ≥2 children of differing
117	material). Two leaks let it happen anyway:
118	
119	1. **`Branch.virtualLodCell`** (`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/raycast/Branch.java:216-229`)
120	   copies a coarse node's descriptor **verbatim** into a synthesized virtual
121	   cell — correct when synthesizing a real LOD aggregate (`lodSize > 1`),
122	   wrong when `lodSize == 1`, because a coarse *pruned* node
123	   (`children == null`) can still have `polar() != null` even though it's
124	   being treated as homogeneous. (Root enabler, NOT to be fixed in this pass:
125	   `OctreeManager.sameAcousticCell` (~line 326) has a same-`Block`-instance
126	   shortcut that doesn't check impedance equality, so a "homogeneous" pruned
127	   node can retain a polar descriptor baked from differing materials. This is
128	   a known follow-up, out of scope here.)
129	2. **`Cast.getBlock`** (`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/raycast/Cast.java`,
130	   ~lines 865-880) has an early return `if (branch.size > 1) return branch;`
131	   which hands back the raw coarse (possibly polarized) branch directly,
132	   bypassing the single-material `liveLeaf(...)` resolution the rest of the
133	   method already computes unconditionally. **This is the dominant path**:
134	   the live-leaf override at `Cast.java` ~line 189
135	   (`if (lodBranch.size == 1) { Branch live = getBlock(normalized); ... }`)
136	   always fires when `requestedLod == 1` (i.e., whenever `frustumSize < 2`),
137	   so `getBlock`'s bug is what actually leaks polarity into small frustums in
138	   practice.
139	
140	`Branch.getAtLod(pos, 1)` itself always returns a size-1 node (real leaf or
141	virtual) — it's not the source of the bug. `Cast.finest = tree.get(queryPos)`
142	(~line 186) is currently only used for the `virtualLod` debug flag, not
143	guaranteed size-1 either.
144	
145	### The fix (two prongs + one guard, no other files touched)
146	
147	1. **`Branch.virtualLodCell`**: when `lodSize == 1`, do **not** copy
148	   `descriptor` verbatim — bake a genuine single-material leaf descriptor
149	   instead, mirroring the pattern `Branch.neighbor`'s coarser-replication path
150	   already uses (~`Branch.java:339-342`): `imp = material.impedance()` →
151	   `new NodeDescriptor(imp, imp, imp, NaN, null)` (or `EMPTY` when material is
152	   null). Keep verbatim copy behavior for `lodSize > 1` (real LOD aggregation
153	   must be unaffected — this is directly tested, see below).
154	2. **`Cast.getBlock`**: delete the `if (branch.size > 1) return branch;`
155	   early return — always return `liveLeaf(block, shape, mat, state)`; those
156	   values are already computed unconditionally earlier in the method, so this
157	   costs nothing extra. (Bonus: this also incidentally fixes a latent bug
158	   where `resolveShape(branch)` on a coarse branch reads shape geometry from
159	   `branch.start`, a different block than the one actually queried.)
160	3. **Guard** (defensive, add near `Cast.java:296` where
161	   `Branch.NodeDescriptor branchDescriptor = branch.descriptor;` is read):
162	   `assert emissionCast || cellSize > 1 || branchDescriptor.polar() == null : "1³ cell resolved a polarized descriptor";`
163	
164	**Do not touch the N/E/D forward-survey code** (`FrustumLod.classify`,
165	`Cast.surveyForward`, the `cellSize > 1` guard around `Cast.java:399-403`).
166	That code is correct as-is and unrelated to this bug — an earlier proposal to
167	patch the survey guard was explicitly rejected by the project owner as
168	treating a symptom, not the cause. Do not "undo" any of that recent work.
169	
170	Once fixed, CUBE-shaped small cells fall through to plain axis-aligned DDA
171	with **zero additional code**: `ShapeTraversal.resolve` already returns
172	`Result.voxel()` for full cubes at `cellSize==1`, and with `polar()` correctly

227	## Task C — dual-derived polarity alignment
228	
229	### Requirement (verbatim from the project owner)
230	"If a beam/frustum/ray enters mostly aligned with polarity, but near the
231	point on the cube where the tangent line is, it should be treated as ~halfway
232	between the two. Basically, get the average vector of (`<incident point <->
233	center of octant>` + `<incident angle>`) / 2 (the mean) before running the
234	polarity alignment calculation." **Approved as-is, no changes requested.**
235	
236	### Current implementation
237	`Physics.polarAlignment(Vec3d rayNorm, Vec3d polNorm)`
238	(`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/Physics.java:42-45`) is purely
239	`dot = rayNorm·polNorm; return dot*dot` — two direction vectors in, no
240	position/octant context. Three call sites in `Cast.raycast()` (one method
241	body, lines ~172-447), all of which already have `pposition` (incident
242	point), `cellBase` (octant min corner), and `cellSize` (octant edge length)
243	in local scope with **zero new plumbing required**:
244	- `Cast.java:302` — `polarizedImpedance(branchDescriptor, vector)` → internal
245	  `polarBlendWeight(descriptor, vector)` (`Cast.java:528-541`) →
246	  `Physics.polarAlignment(vector.normalize(), pol.normalize())` at
247	  `Cast.java:540`. Feeds `Physics.blendImpedance`, which sets `newImpedance`
248	  — **this affects real R/T physics, not just cosmetics.**
249	- `Cast.java:353` — same `polarBlendWeight(branchDescriptor, vector)`, feeds
250	  the notable-interaction/commit-reflect gate (`Cast.java:342-371`).
251	- `Cast.java:442-444` — `this.lastPolarAlignment = Physics.polarAlignment(...)`,
252	  feeds `FrustumLod.nextFrustumSize`'s growth/shrink blend.
253	
254	### Approved design
255	
256	**Sign, resolved definitively**: `octantCenter - incidentPoint`, normalized
257	— pointing **inward**, from the crossing point toward the cell center. Proof
258	by limit cases (both confirmed by exact closed-form arithmetic, not just
259	intuition):
260	- Dead-center entry (ray aimed straight at center): `C - P` is parallel to
261	  the ray → blend is a no-op → alignment equals the current pure-angle
262	  result, unchanged. (The reversed sign `P - C` degenerates to the zero
263	  vector exactly in this case — proof the sign must be `C - P`.)
264	- Tangent entry with a fully pol-aligned ray: `C - P` is nearly perpendicular
265	  to the ray; the normalized sum is the exact angular bisector, 45° off the
266	  ray. Alignment becomes `cos²45° = exactly 0.5` — precisely the "~halfway"
267	  spec, with no fudge factor needed.
268	- Degenerate guard: if `(C - P)` has `lengthSquared() < 1e-12`, or the sum
269	  `rayNorm + normalize(C-P)` has `lengthSquared() < 1e-12`, fall back to raw
270	  `normalize(rayNorm)`.
271	
272	**API** — add to `Physics.java`, alongside `polarAlignment` (do **not**
273	change `polarAlignment`'s existing signature; it's tested and stays as the
274	final-stage primitive):
275	
276	```java
277	/** Blended "effective ray norm": normalize(rayNorm + normalize(octantCenter - incidentPoint)).
278	 *  Falls back to normalize(rayNorm) when either the offset or the sum is degenerate. */
279	public static Vec3d dualDerivedNorm(@NotNull Vec3d rayNorm, @NotNull Vec3d incidentPoint, @NotNull Vec3d octantCenter)
280	
281	/** polarAlignment(dualDerivedNorm(...), polNorm) — position-aware alignment. */
282	public static double dualDerivedAlignment(@NotNull Vec3d rayNorm, @NotNull Vec3d incidentPoint, @NotNull Vec3d octantCenter, @NotNull Vec3d polNorm)
283	```
284	
285	`dualDerivedNorm` should normalize `rayNorm` internally (don't rely on
286	call sites pre-normalizing). Implement as sum-then-normalize (mathematically
287	identical to average-then-normalize).
288	
289	**Uniform application**: apply at **all three** call sites (302, 353,
290	442-444) — the impedance-blend and reflect/permeate-gate sites must never
291	disagree with each other (they currently share one `w`), and the frustum-
292	growth telemetry site must reflect the same formula for debugging to make
293	sense. One helper, three call sites:
294	- Compute `Vec3d octantCenter = cellBase.add(cellSize * 0.5, cellSize * 0.5, cellSize * 0.5)`
295	  once in `raycast()` after `cellBase`/`cellSize` are established.
296	- Change the private `Cast.polarBlendWeight(descriptor, vector)` →
297	  `polarBlendWeight(descriptor, vector, incidentPoint, octantCenter)`
298	  (private, no external API break), swapping its `Physics.polarAlignment`
299	  call for `Physics.dualDerivedAlignment`. `polarizedImpedance` gets the
300	  same two extra params and forwards them.
301	- Site 442-444 calls `Physics.dualDerivedAlignment(vector.normalize(), pposition, octantCenter, polar.normalize())`
302	  directly, using whatever `vector` is current at that point in the method
303	  (it may have been reassigned by `permeationBend` earlier in the same call
304	  — that's correct: post-bend alignment is what the growth blend should see).

548	**1. The double-cover predicate** — new pure static in `FrustumLod.java`:
549	```java

551	        Vec3d cellBase, int cellSize, Vec3d exitPos,
552	        @Nullable Vec3d polar, double candidateSize, double currentSize)

554	Logic:
555	- `polar == null || polar.lengthSquared() <= 1e-12` → `false`.
556	- `candidateSize <= currentSize` (no growth attempted, e.g. a reflect leg) →
557	  `false`.
558	- `a` = argmax `|polar component|`; `s` = sign of `polar[a]` (+ points toward

561	- Clearance from the exit point to the boundary, measured toward solid:
562	  `clearance = max(0, s > 0 ? mid - exitPos[a] : exitPos[a] - mid)`
563	  (negative = already past the plane → clamp to 0, always triggers).
564	- Return `candidateSize / 2.0 > clearance`.

inputs' range if the inputs are sane).

descriptor data, not an actual physics divergence... unless investigation shows
otherwise.
